name: Ray-marching on 3D Gaussians
definition: A ray-marching algorithm implemented on 3D Gaussians to study the impact of approximations like spatial overlap and sorting in 3DGS.
summary: Ray-marching on 3D Gaussians is a volume rendering method that evaluates Gaussian mixture fields along camera rays to accurately resolve primitive overlap and self-attenuation, unlike rasterization-based splatting.
